local UIWindowBase = require("FairyGUI.UIWindowBase")

---@class UIWindow: UIWindowBase
---@field s_Instances table<UIWindow, any> static
local UIWindow = class("UIWindow", UIWindowBase)

---ctor
---@param cmpCls IComponent
---@param asyncMode boolean
function UIWindow:ctor(cmpCls, asyncMode, ...)
    ---@type IComponent
    self.m_cmpCls = cmpCls
    ---@type any[]
    self.m_ctorArgs = {...}
    
    local packages = self:GetAllPackages()
    UIWindowBase.ctor(self, cmpCls.URL, packages, asyncMode)
end

---GetAllPackages
---@return string[]
function UIWindow:GetAllPackages()
    local extend = self:ExtendPackages()
    local packages = self.m_cmpCls.PACKAGES
    if not extend then
        return packages
    end
    local pkgSet = {}
    for _, pkg in ipairs(packages) do
        pkgSet[pkg] = 1
    end
    for _, pkg in ipairs(extend) do
        pkgSet[pkg] = 1
    end
    return table.keys(pkgSet)
end

---ExtendPackages
---@overload 返回需要扩充的依赖包
---@return string[]|nil
function UIWindow:ExtendPackages()
    return nil
end

---BeforeCreate 创建组件前需先确定所有扩展已绑定
---@protected
function UIWindow:BeforeCreate()
    self.m_cmpCls:InitBinders()
end

---OnInit 创建组件之后，界面打开之间会调用该方法，可在该方法中进行初始化操作
---@protected
function UIWindow:OnInit()
    if not self.modal then
        -- 非模态窗口充满全屏
        local root = self.root
        self:SetSize(root.width, root.height)
    end
    
    self:OnUIInit()
    self.m_inited = true

    if self.m_ctorArgs then
        self:SetData(unpack(self.m_ctorArgs))
    end
    self.m_ctorArgs = false
end

function UIWindow:TryShowAgain(...)
    if self.m_inited then
        self:SetData(...)
        self:BringToFront()
    else
        self.m_ctorArgs = {...}
    end
end

---@overload
function UIWindow:OnUIInit()
    
end

---SetData
---@overload
function UIWindow:SetData(...)
    
end


return UIWindow
